authoredNote: Fixture written first from the #868 contract (the SFC seam shifts line_number AND the metadata line mirrors); the numbers were then read off the post-fix run and agree with the file's own text — `@sealed` 24 / `class Service` 25, `@inject("db")` 26 / `pool = 1` 27, `@sealed` 29 / `method() {}` 30, with the script block offset 14 recorded on every delegated row.
rationale: M49 (#868), vue half of the SFC SEAM contract. A decorated class in a script block is analyzed by the JS delegate, so its rows are SCRIPT-relative and the container must shift them to file lines. `line_number` was shifted (the #825 round); the metadata LINE MIRRORS were not, so on this exact shape `references Service -> sealed` claimed line_number=24 while its own metadata said decoratorLine=10 — the payload contradicting itself, with `sfcLineOffset: 14` recorded on the very row that disagreed, i.e. an edge that is auditable and still wrong. The fix shifts numeric line mirrors (and line lists, e.g. a symbol's `decoratorLines`) by the same offset. The template ABOVE the script is what makes this reachable: with the script on line 1 the offset is 0 and a missing shift is invisible, which is why every earlier vue fixture missed it — and why this one is written with a comment header that keeps the offset non-zero. The symbol rows pin the list mirror too: `Service` carries decorators=["sealed"] with decoratorLines=[24], the line `@sealed` is written on.

Its generic `v === null` branch (the line_number:null convention, run-fixtures.ts:344) is evaluated BEFORE the `meta.` branch and it `continue`s, so the `meta.x: null` semantics added for exactly this purpose (run-fixtures.ts:371-377, 'M59 fixed this hole for line_number; it is the SAME hole one level down') are UNREACHABLE for a null value: a `meta.x: null` constraint matches on the other keys alone.
